items.t: Apple “Has No Idea What It’s Doing” in AI. Oh, and It’s Building Its Own AI Agent Too
items.sum: Key TakeawaysApple is building its own AI agent that can run devices, browse the web and write code, which puts it up against Anthropic, OpenAI and Alphabet’s Google. Apple trades at 37x forward earnings, the price of a company that collects fees from AI, yet its agent will start from models rebuilt on Google’s Gemini.
